items.meaning: Three plans per car: Basic 99 lei (4 washes a month), Plus 149 (unlimited exterior), Premium 249 (unlimited everything); the plate number is the id.
items.row: 3 plans: basic 99 lei (4 washes/month), plus 149 (unlimited exterior), premium 249 (unlimited everything). per car, plate number is the id

items.meaning: Unlimited plans and Basic allow at most one wash per day.
items.row: unlimited means max 1 wash per day, otherwise the taxi guys will kill us; actually basic also 1 per day max

items.meaning: A second car on the same account gets 20 percent off with its own plate.
items.row: second car 20% off, same account, separate plates

items.meaning: Cancel any time; the subscription ends at the end of the paid month, no refunds.
items.row: cancel anytime, ends at the end of the paid month, no refunds

items.meaning: Card on file charged on the 1st; failed payments retry on the 3rd and 5th, then the subscription is suspended.
items.row: card on file, charged on the 1st, if it fails retry on the 3rd and 5th then suspend

items.meaning: Receipts by email; monthly invoices for companies with a CUI, sent to e-Factura.
items.row: receipts by email, invoices for companies with CUI, monthly; for companies it has to go to e-factura, that is law now

items.meaning: The gate camera reads the plate and opens if the plan is active; staff see the plan on the tablet.
items.row: the gate reads the plate (we have the camera already, Hikvision) and opens if the plan is active, staff see the plan on the tablet

items.meaning: Gift cards for 3 or 6 months with a code on paper.
items.row: gift cards for xmas, 3 or 6 months, code on paper

items.meaning: A subscription can be paused for up to 2 months a year.
items.row: pause: a sub can be paused up to 2 months a year, e.g. when they go abroad

items.meaning: A customer can change the plate at most once a month; staff can always change it.
items.row: plate change: customer changes the plate himself, max once a month, staff can always
